# Good, I have 16 transactions. Since I used direction="sent", these should be outgoing. Let me verify all are sent by Cody Smith and sum the amounts.

    receiver = t.get("receiver", {}).get("email", "")
    amount = t.get("amount", 0)
    print(f"ID: {t['transaction_id']}, Amount: {amount}, Sender: {sender}, Receiver: {receiver}")
